name: echo-dispatch-adapter
description: A second, NON-MESH @operator/projectkit dispatch executor — the executable proof of the One-Line Boundary Test. Accepts a DispatchEnvelope on POST /api/projectkit/concerns, validates every Concern with the published validateConcern, and returns the projectkit Ack shape (plus the poll/Callback shape on GET). Imports nothing from mesh/control-plane.
